name: HolyMind — Line-only Current
request: The non-piano scrolling electricity must sound only while the visual carrier is actually moving along its line. Otherwise that sound must be silent.

behavior.audible: Only during fresh, visible connector travel in either direction, with trusted scroll intent and sound enabled. The existing +8 dB current level is retained.
behavior.silent: Docked at a station, stopped midline, pinned Assemble/layer scrolling, absent line, offscreen carrier, programmatic navigation/reflow, or stale renderer evidence.
behavior.piano: The ordered Mozart score still follows scrolling independently. It can play during the pinned Assemble while current is zero. Natural piano releases and room resonance are not gated.
behavior.ambient_and_cues: Background ambience, brain-tap sounds, action/arrival cues and their own controls remain separate and unchanged in their source assets.
behavior.source_of_truth: The same continuity render frame that writes the visible connector reports route endpoints, visible segment, in-viewport position and progress movement. Generic scroll speed alone no longer authorizes this sound.
behavior.gate: Normally closed post-envelope gain, after unchanged +8 dB presence stage. 8 ms open edge, 12 ms close to exact zero; 50 ms movement-cadence tolerance; 100 ms audio-clock lease fails closed on missing reports. No new permanent frame loop.
behavior.unchanged_controls: Master mute/volume, independent flow/ambient/piano controls, gesture unlock, lifecycle policy, always-on visual motion and mobile-only brain-first layout remain.

coverage: All ten visual line transfers down and up; stationary midline and real hold intervals; pinned layer scroll with piano continuing; navigation/reflow, flow mute, visibility lifecycle and widths 320–1440. In-page frame sampling captures brief travel rather than a late endpoint snapshot.
native_touch: Chromium DevTools native touch input in mobile emulation; not a physical device.

limitations.note: Measured bus silence and visual gating in browser automation; not a microphone recording or a physical iPhone listening test.
